# Med 3-4 Academic Program Committee Meeting Minutes 12/21/2009
Program Committee Student Rep Attendance Presiding Chair: Mary McIlroy, MD

Recording Secretary: Sean Bragg

Call To Order: 4:07 pm

Adjourned: 5:30

Location: B124 Graves Hall
Arnold, Mark √ Khandelwal, Sorabh Barin, Kamrin √ Kman, Nicholas Bartholomew, Deb √ Ledford, Cindy Bourekas, Eric Letson, Alan

√ Bowyer, Brian Liston, Beth

Clinchot, Dan Lynn, Joanne √ Cohen, Dan √ McIlroy, Mary √ Cronau, Holly Muscarella, Pete

Ecklar, Pat Niedermier, Julie Essig, Garth O'Dorisio, Nathan Harzman, Alan Pfeil, Sheryl

√ Hasbrouck, Carol Rose, Stephen √ Hoyle, Chad Scharschmidt, Thomas

Kapoor, Ritu Shim, Rosemarie		 Bashaw, Hillary Fu, Julia

√ Gerstman, Jacob Ho, Vincent House, Melissa Rose, Maggie Sauers, Lynn Schroeder, Catherine Subbarao, Catherine

√ Tam, Marty Vogt, Keith Voss, Sarah

√ Wolfson, Anna
AGENDA ## DISCUSSIONS and CONCLUSIONS I. Opening - A. Approval of Minutes: November 16, 2009 meeting minutes approved. - B. Announcements: a. Dr. Kman new Clerkship Director for DOC-1. Dr. Khandelwal new Assoc Director of Med 3-4. Faculty Development brochure "Teaching for Optimal Patient Care with Electronic Medical Records" printed and available for distribution to dept faculty. - b. - c. ## ACTIONS / FOLLOW-UP ## II. Business A. CAPS presentation: CAPS will take information gathered and discuss at future APC meetings. They will return february or march to the Med 3-4 APC meeting to propose ideas. The Clinical Assessment and Problem Solving (CAPS) program representatives gave an overview of their current Med 1-2 curriculum (handout). They listed some suggestions for how CAPS could function in the 3rd and 4th years, and opened the floor for discussion.
